reason: My customers just call me and I write the udhaar in my diary at night, and that works. Another thing to learn and look at every day, I will not keep it up even if the first 3 months are free.
objection: Most of my orders come on the phone call, I don't type. I don't believe it will pick up a call properly, and I don't want to put my whole udhaar khata in something I can't see on paper.
would_change_my_mind: Someone from my own market, a shop like mine, showing me that it really catches phone-call orders and that my diary udhaar gets copied in for me, with nothing for me to do daily.
